question: Where should the kūṭa-koṣṭha and related elements be placed?
premises: it is kūṭa-koṣṭha and so forth
inference: The kūṭa-koṣṭha and related elements are to be placed in the middle.
uncertainties: exact middle of which larger structure
plain_english: That same kūṭa-koṣṭha and the rest are to be placed in the middle, O best twice-born.
